observations: Game console with a distinct three-tier black chassis design.
A decorative skin on the top of the console reads 'GOD OF WAR DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION'.
Two wireless game controllers with camouflage patterns (one green, one grey/white) are placed on top.
The console is in a retail environment; background shelves contain electronics boxes labeled 'CHARGE6', 'FLIP7', and 'Q185'.
No physical game discs or game cases are visible in any of the photos.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI RICHARD IHEYI' is visible across the images.

claims.evidence: The three-tier chassis design is the unique physical identifier for the PS4 Pro model.
Two controllers are clearly visible in photos 0, 1, and 2.
No physical discs are shown; games may be digital and tied to a personal account which is not a reliable transfer of ownership.
Internal storage capacity can only be confirmed via a photo of the system information screen.

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional or have a faulty HDMI output.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the dashboard and launching a game.

risks.risk: The controllers may be third-party clones (counterfeits), especially given the presence of knockoff 'JBL' boxes (Flip 7, Charge 6) in the background.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the manufacturer stickers on the back of the controllers.

risks.risk: The internal hard drive may be smaller than 1TB or failing.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Settings > Storage' menu screen.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be unable to read games.
risks.proof: A video of a disc being inserted and the game icon appearing on the menu.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on, loading a game, and ejecting a disc.
Photo of the 'System Storage' screen showing the HDD capacity.
Photos of the back of both controllers to verify authenticity.
Photos of the 7 game discs if they are physical copies.
response.reason: The item is clearly a PS4 Pro based on its physical form. It can be priced at its worst-case scenario (non-functional, 500GB, clone controllers, no games) until the seller provides proof of condition and authenticity.
